key_insight: Adaptive optimization of discrete PDE residuals can recover highly accurate self-similar singularity profiles without prescribed far-field conditions.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers computational scientists a high-accuracy numerical tool for studying PDE blow-up that complements AI-based methods.
method: Represent fields with overlapping local Chebyshev patches and a mapped asymptotic patch.
Factor out leading power laws, optimize far-field amplitudes, and refine using Chebyshev-coefficient decay.
Minimize the discrete loss using automatically differentiated Gauss–Newton iterations with Levenberg–Marquardt damping.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports O(10^-14)-level accuracy for Burgers profiles, O(10^-14)–O(10^-10) residuals for generalized De Gregorio equations, and O(10^-8) residuals in a local region for 2D Boussinesq equations.
watch_item: Small numerical residuals do not by themselves prove singularity formation, and the reported Boussinesq result is local.
paper_title: Discovery of Singularities in Partial Differential Equations Using Adaptive Numerical Discretizations
